exam_details_html:
The Project Management Professional (PMP) exam is a globally recognized certification exam administered by the Project Management Institute (PMI). It assesses an individual's knowledge, skills, and competencies in project management based on industry best practices outlined in the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK) guide.

Exam Format:
- The PMP exam is a computer-based test (CBT) consisting of 200 multiple-choice questions.
- Out of the 200 questions, 25 pretest questions do not contribute to the final score. These questions are used for research and development purposes.
- The remaining 175 questions are scored, and a psychometric analysis determines the passing score.

Exam Content:
- The PMP exam covers various project management domains, processes, and concepts. The content is based on the PMBOK guide but also includes additional topics that reflect the evolving practices in the field.
- The exam is designed to assess the candidate's understanding of project management principles, frameworks, and techniques across the following domains:
  1. People: Evaluating the skills and competencies required to effectively lead and manage project teams.
  2. Process: Assessing the knowledge of project management processes, their inputs, tools and techniques, and outputs.
  3. Business Environment: Testing the understanding of how projects align with organizational strategies and factors that influence project success.

Exam Duration:
- The PMP exam has a time limit of 240 minutes (4 hours) to complete the 200 questions.
- It is recommended to allocate sufficient time for reviewing and double-checking answers to ensure accuracy.

Exam Eligibility:
- To be eligible for the PMP exam, candidates must meet specific educational and professional experience requirements set by PMI.
- For individuals with a four-year degree (bachelor's or global equivalent), a minimum of 3 years (36 months) of project management experience is required, along with 4,500 hours leading and directing projects.
- For individuals without a four-year degree, a minimum of 5 years (60 months) of project management experience is required, along with 7,500 hours leading and directing projects.

Exam Preparation:
- It is essential to prepare thoroughly for the PMP exam to increase the chances of success.
- Candidates can leverage various study resources, including Certification Planner's PMP In-person classroom, PMP live online training, self-learning course, and PMP corporate training.

Maintaining PMP Certification:
- Once certified, PMP credential holders are required to maintain their certification through continuous professional development.
- This involves earning 60 Professional Development Units (PDUs) every three years through various activities, such as attending seminars, conferences, and educational programs related to project management.

The PMP certification demonstrates an individual's commitment to the project management profession and validates their knowledge and skills in leading successful projects. By understanding the exam format, content, and eligibility criteria, aspiring PMP candidates can effectively prepare and navigate their way toward achieving this prestigious certification.

exam_details_html:
There are no prerequisites to attending the CP PMP training course. However, to appear for the PMP exam, you must have the following education and work experience. 

 To appear for the PMP certification exam, you should either: 

  • Hold a Secondary degree (high school diploma, associate degree, or global equivalent) along with 7500 hours of experience in leading a project and 35 hours of formal learning in project management. 

or

  • Hold a four-year degree with 4500 hours of directly leading projects and 35 hours of formal learning in project management.

PMI requires the 35 Contact hour certificate to approve your application, and the Certification Planner will provide the same once you complete the four days of classroom training.

PMP Certification process: 

Step 1: Register yourself on the PMI.org website

Step 2: Become a PMI member by paying a $139 annual fee (optional)

Step 3: Submit your PMP application by providing education, work experience, and training course details

Step 4: Wait for approval. It may take 5-7 business days if the application is not selected for an audit

Step 5: Application approved; now pay the exam fee for PMI

Step 6: Select an exam center, date, and timing to book your exam

Step 7: Read the exam details below

The new PMP exam format is comprised of:

  • 180 questions (175 = scored questions, 5 = Unscored (pretest) questions)
  • The PMP exam is to be completed in 230 minutes.
  • One additional break for a total of two 10-minute intervals for computer-based tests. No scheduled breaks for paper-based exams.
  • Question types:
    • Multiple choice
    • Multiple responses
    • Matching
    • Fill-in-the-blank questions
    • Drag and drop
    • Hot Spot (Graphic) questions

Examination cost included in the course fee:               Member: US$405.00                   Non-member: US$555.00

  • If you have a bachelor's degree, you will also need four years (6,000 hours) of Program Management experience

The program encompasses the knowledge and skills required to drive process improvement, lead projects, and achieve significant business results. The curriculum includes the following modules:

Module 1: Introduction to Lean Six Sigma

  • Overview of Lean Six Sigma Principles and Benefits
  • Roles and responsibilities of Lean Six Sigma professionals
  • DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) methodology overview

Module 2: Define Phase

  • Project identification and selection
  • Stakeholder analysis and project charter development
  • Voice of the Customer (VOC) analysis and CTQ identification

Module 3: Measure Phase

  • Data collection strategies and techniques
  • Process mapping and value stream analysis
  • Data analysis and graphical tools
  • Measurement system analysis (MSA) and Gage R&R

Module 4: Analyze Phase

  • Root cause analysis techniques
  • Statistical analysis tools, including hypothesis testing and regression analysis
  • Failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA)
  • Design of Experiments (DOE) concepts

Module 5: Improve Phase

  • Solution generation and selection methods
  • Lean tools for process improvement
  • Implementation planning and piloting
  • Lean Six Sigma project management

Module 6: Control Phase

  • Statistical process control (SPC) and control charting
  • Control plan development and implementation
  • Sustaining improvements and change management
  • Lean Six Sigma project closure and handover

Module 7: Focused Black Belt Materials

  • Advanced statistical techniques for data analysis
  • Advanced DOE and optimization methods
  • Advanced process capability analysis
  • Lean leadership and change management

Module 8: Lean Six Sigma Integration

  • Integration of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Advanced Lean tools and techniques
  • Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) concepts
  • Lean Six Sigma project selection and prioritization

Throughout the training, participants will engage in hands-on exercises, case studies, and simulations to apply their learning in practical scenarios. The program also includes mentorship and guidance from experienced Lean Six Sigma instructors. By the end of the training, participants will have the knowledge and skills to successfully pass the Dual Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and Black Belt certification exams and drive impactful process improvement initiatives in their organizations.

Ignite Your Career: Obtain Ethical Hacking Certifications

The Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) provides an in-depth understanding of ethical hacking phases, various attack vectors, and preventative countermeasures. It will teach you how hackers think and act so you will be better positioned to set up your security infrastructure and defend against attacks. By understanding system weaknesses and vulnerabilities, the CEH course helps students learn to protect their organizations and strengthen their security controls to minimize the risk of a malicious attack.

This course helps you master an ethical hacking methodology that can be used in penetration testing to lawfully assess the security of a system. This course delivers in-demand ethical hacking skills while preparing you for the internationally-recognized Certified Ethical Hacker certification exam from EC-Council.

After completing this course, attendees will be able to:

  • Information security controls, laws, and standards
  • Various types of footprinting, footprinting tools, and countermeasures
  • Network scanning techniques and scanning countermeasures
  • Enumeration techniques and enumeration countermeasures
  • Vulnerability analysis to identify security loopholes in the target organization’s network, communication infrastructure, and end systems
  • System hacking methodology, steganography, steganalysis attacks, and covering tracks to discover system and network vulnerabilities
  • Different types of malware (Trojan, Virus, worms, etc.), system auditing for malware attacks, malware analysis, and countermeasures
  • Packet sniffing techniques to discover network vulnerabilities and countermeasures to defend against sniffing.
  • Social engineering techniques and how to identify theft attacks to audit human-level vulnerabilities and social engineering countermeasures
  • DoS/DDoS attack techniques and tools to audit a target and DoS/DDoS countermeasures
  • Session hijacking techniques to discover network-level session management, authentication/authorization, and cryptographic weaknesses and countermeasures
  • Web server attacks and a comprehensive attack methodology to audit vulnerabilities in web server infrastructure, and countermeasures

COBIT Certificate: Elevate Your Expertise

This course provides the preparation and knowledge needed to pass the COBIT 2019 Foundation certification exam, including a comprehensive understanding of the COBIT 2019 framework, the six key governance principles, and the components of a comprehensive governance system. You will learn about COBIT 2019’s forty governance and management objectives, how performance is managed, and how to design and implement a tailored governance system for your enterprise.

A greater grasp of IT governance and management is the goal of this COBIT 2019 Foundation course. COBIT is a comprehensive library of information, tools, models, and resources that enable business executives to achieve their goals for effective governance. COBIT 2019 FOUNDATION, the most recent version of the industry-leading framework for these activities, best practices for corporate information and technology governance and management

Through this COBIT 2019 Foundation training, participants will learn:

  • Integrating IT goals with strategic business objectives, utilizing technologies meant to give governance a wider view and practitioners greater flexibility in implementing the strategy.
  • The value of IT, the resources required, and the dangers involved in creating a mature partnership between the business and IT.
  • How each of the several IT governance frameworks, such as ITIL and NIST, operates and their advantages and disadvantages.

  • Terms and concepts that are essential

  • Components and the governance system
  • Management and governance goals
  • Management of performance

exam_details_html:
• Format: The Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification exam consists of 100 multiple-choice questions.
  • Duration: The exam has a time limit of 3 hours (180 minutes) to complete all the questions.
  • Passing Score: To pass the exam, participants must achieve a minimum score of 65%.
  • Open Book: The exam allows participants to use reference materials, making it an open-book format. This enables candidates to access resources and tools to support their problem-solving and decision-making during the exam.
  • Access and Attempts: Participants will have 7 days of access to the exam platform, allowing them to choose a convenient time to take the exam. They will also have up to 3 attempts to pass the exam within the given 7-day period.

Exam Preparation:

  • Study Materials: Participants are encouraged to thoroughly review the course materials provided during the training, including lecture notes, study guides, practice exercises, and case studies. These materials cover the key concepts, methodologies, and tools of Lean Six Sigma Black Belt.
  • Additional Resources: Candidates can supplement their preparation with recommended reference books, online resources, and practice exams. These resources can provide further insights and help reinforce understanding of the Lean Six Sigma principles and techniques.
  • Practice Questions: Engaging in practice questions and mock exams can help participants familiarize themselves with the exam format, improve their time management skills, and assess their knowledge and readiness for the actual certification exam.

Tips for Success:

  • Time Management: Use your time wisely during the exam. Read each question carefully, and allocate sufficient time to answer all questions within the given time limit.
  • Understand the Concepts: Focus on understanding the underlying concepts and principles of Lean Six Sigma, as the exam questions may require applying these concepts to real-world scenarios.
  • Utilize Reference Materials: Take advantage of the open-book format and leverage your reference materials effectively to find relevant information, formulas, and tools to support your answers.
  • Practice, Practice, Practice: Regularly practice with sample questions and mock exams to familiarize yourself with the question types, improve your accuracy, and build confidence.

By following these exam preparation tips and dedicating adequate time and effort to studying, participants can increase their chances of passing the Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification exam and earning their well-deserved certification.

In the Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification course, you will learn a comprehensive set of skills and knowledge to lead and manage process improvement projects within organizations. This course covers various topics and methodologies that are essential for driving operational excellence and achieving measurable results. Here is a description of what you will learn in this course:

  1. Process Improvement: You will gain a deep understanding of Lean Six Sigma principles and methodologies, including DMAIC (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) and DMADV (Define, Measure, Analyze, Design, Verify). You will learn how to identify process inefficiencies, eliminate waste, and optimize workflows to enhance productivity and quality.

  2. Data Analysis: You will acquire the skills to collect, analyze, and interpret data using statistical tools and techniques. You will learn how to apply statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, and control charts to make data-driven decisions and identify root causes of problems.

  3. Project Management: This course will teach you project management methodologies and tools specifically tailored for Lean Six Sigma projects. You will learn how to define project goals, create project charters, develop project plans, manage resources, and effectively communicate with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

  4. Problem-solving: You will learn systematic problem-solving techniques such as root cause analysis, fishbone diagrams, and failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA). These tools will enable you to identify and address the underlying causes of problems, ensuring sustainable solutions and preventing future issues.

  5. Leadership: As a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, you will develop leadership skills to effectively lead cross-functional teams and drive organizational change. You will learn how to engage and motivate team members, facilitate effective communication, and overcome resistance to change.

  6. Lean Six Sigma Methodology: This course will provide a comprehensive understanding of the Lean Six Sigma methodology as a whole. You will learn how to integrate Lean principles, focused on waste reduction and process flow improvement, with Six Sigma, focused on variation reduction and data-driven decision-making. This combined approach will enable you to achieve significant process improvements and deliver tangible business outcomes.

By completing this course, you will be equipped with the knowledge and tools necessary to lead complex process improvement projects, analyze data, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement within your organization. You will become a certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, recognized for your expertise in process optimization and organizational excellence.
